title: Erkennung von Prompt Injection und Jailbreak
description: As a security admin, I want attempts to manipulate the model or the checker to be detected, so that malicious prompts do not enter the registry.

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates a prompt whose content tries to override previous instructions
acceptance_criteria.then: the version reaches status FLAGGED with a finding of category PROMPT_INJECTION
and: the finding contains a redacted excerpt, the position and the reasoning
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-018-injection-jailbreak-detection.feature: An injection attempt is detected and blocks the prompt

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates an ordinary customer support prompt
acceptance_criteria.then: the version reaches status APPROVED and no finding is reported

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt contains text that instructs the classifier to report APPROVED
acceptance_criteria.then: the version is classified by the content itself and the injected instruction has no effect
and: the checker prompt keeps its system instruction and the finding is recorded
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-018-injection-jailbreak-detection.feature: The checker is not manipulable by the content it checks
